name: owl-be-there
description: Find a day everyone can make. Mark your days on a calendar and see what works for the group. No accounts.
author: Willi Thiel

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @owl/server && npm run build -w @owl/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @owl/server && concurrently -n shared,tsc,server,client -c blue,yellow,green,cyan "npm run watch -w @owl/shared" "npm run watch -w @owl/server" "npm run dev -w @owl/server" "npm run dev -w @owl/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.scan:secrets: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/repo:ro aquasec/trivy:0.73.0 fs --scanners secret --exit-code 1 --skip-dirs '**/node_modules' --skip-dirs '**/dist' --skip-dirs coverage --skip-dirs playwright-report --skip-dirs test-results /repo && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/repo:ro ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:v8.30.1@sha256:c00b6bd0aeb3071cbcb79009cb16a60dd9e0a7c60e2be9ab65d25e6bc8abbb7f git --redact --no-banner --log-opts=--all /repo
scripts.ci:local: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run scan:secrets && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:tz && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
